sloka: कुसुमानि अपचिन्वन्ती चचार रुचिरानना ।अनर्हा अरण्य वासस्य सा तम् रत्नमयम् मृगम् ॥३-४२-३२॥
transliteration: kusumāni apacinvantī cacāra rucirānanā ।anarhā araṇya vāsasya sā tam ratnamayam mṛgam ॥3-42-32॥

translations.english: The great lady Sita, unworthy of dwelling in the forest, saw the wonderful deer decked with gems, with spots of pearls all over the body.
